mechanisms.name: Two-phase step: execute_model then sample_tokens
mechanisms.trigger: every engine-core step, over collective_rpc
mechanisms.observable: the forward runs and keeps hidden states in ExecuteModelState; sample_tokens consumes that state once and returns tokens, or None when the prior execute failed

mechanisms.name: Persistent request slots: finish, free, add, update
mechanisms.trigger: the start of every non-dummy execute_model
mechanisms.observable: finished and preempted requests free slots in sorted order on every TP rank, new requests take a free slot, streaming chunks re-add, running requests gain block ids

mechanisms.name: KV cache sizing from gpu_memory_utilization and a profiled forward
mechanisms.trigger: once at startup, in init_device and determine_available_memory
mechanisms.observable: startup fails if free memory is under budget; otherwise available = requested - non-KV memory - applied graph estimate, or kv_cache_memory_bytes verbatim
mechanisms.note: reserve_mm_ipc_gpu_memory (the deduction of multimodal IPC memory on both return paths, gpu_worker.py:670,803) is not modeled; the returned budget is the raw figure.

mechanisms.name: KV cache allocation and binding
mechanisms.trigger: once after the engine resolves block count, via initialize_from_config
mechanisms.observable: one zeroed backing allocation per block count, block tables sized by max_model_len, attention groups and connector set up
mechanisms.note: A connector-provided memory pool (get_mem_pool_context, Mooncake style) replacing the CuMem pool is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph capture
mechanisms.trigger: once during compile_or_warm_up_model, unless enforce_eager
mechanisms.observable: descriptors are captured largest first, PIECEWISE then FULL, each after a warmup forward; encoder and speculator graphs follow, then the workspace locks
mechanisms.note: capture_model calls only the decoder capture: the encoder and speculator captures, adaptive profiling batches and lock_workspace in its summary are not steps, and LoRA capture variants are missing.

mechanisms.name: Per-step graph selection: FULL, PIECEWISE or eager
mechanisms.trigger: every forward, in dispatch_cg_and_sync_dp
mechanisms.observable: the batch replays a captured FULL graph, runs PIECEWISE graphs, or runs eager when no candidate is compatible; a padded token count follows the choice
mechanisms.note: Selection on token size and uniform decode is modeled. _is_compatible checks on max_query_len (varlen decode), effective LoRA count and num_ubatches are not.

mechanisms.name: DP rank agreement on padding, graph mode and microbatching
mechanisms.trigger: every forward when data_parallel_size > 1
mechanisms.observable: all ranks all-reduce a 6-row tensor, pad to one token count and mode, or all skip the forward when every rank has zero tokens
mechanisms.note: dispatch cites dp_utils and execute-model titles the step as agreeing across DP ranks, but no all-reduce, padding to the max rank or eager agreement runs; set_forward_context fills a single-rank count instead.

mechanisms.name: Sleep: level 1 offload, level 2 discard
mechanisms.trigger: collective_rpc sleep(level)
mechanisms.observable: weights, runtime and graph pools go to host at level 1 and the rest is released; level 2 keeps only runtime and graphs, saving buffers and retained parameters to CPU; free memory rises
mechanisms.note: enable_nccl_comm_suspend, the ROCm free-memory poll and the sleep_preserve_parameter_names fnmatch rules are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Wake up with deferrable tags
mechanisms.trigger: collective_rpc wake_up(tags)
mechanisms.observable: named deferrable pools and every non-deferrable pool are remapped, offloaded data is copied back, level 2 buffers are restored, and discarded pools return uninitialized (zeroed on ROCm)
mechanisms.note: Code always wakes non-deferrable tags (cudagraph, runtime, workspace). The model wakes cudagraph only when weights is in tags, so wake_up([kv_cache]) leaves graphs unmapped, unlike the code.

mechanisms.name: Selective discard of pools by tag
mechanisms.trigger: collective_rpc discard(tags)
mechanisms.observable: mapped allocations with the tags are released with no backup; an already-asleep allocation keeps its policy and a conflict is logged
mechanisms.note: The model drops the offloaded state of a sleeping tag; the code keeps the host backup of an asleep allocation and only warns, so a later wake restores the data.

mechanisms.name: CuMem pool tagging, trim and expandable-segments swap
mechanisms.trigger: each allocation context: weights, kv_cache, runtime, workspace, cudagraph
mechanisms.observable: allocations carry a tag that decides sleep policy; freed segments of older pools are trimmed; expandable_segments is off inside a pool and restored on exit
mechanisms.note: Allocations are counted per kind, but trimming, the expandable-segments rewrite and the single-instance weights assertion do not run.

mechanisms.name: Sleep backend factory
mechanisms.trigger: the first sleep or wake on a worker
mechanisms.observable: a registered backend is lazily chosen from model_config and declares what it preserves

mechanisms.name: Allocator pool release on shutdown and atexit
mechanisms.trigger: worker shutdown, and interpreter exit through atexit
mechanisms.observable: pool and pluggable allocator references drop before finalization, avoiding a pure-virtual abort

mechanisms.name: Persisted startup memory plan
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_ENABLE_STARTUP_PLAN=1, at determine_available_memory and after capture
mechanisms.observable: a fingerprint match with enough free memory sets kv_cache_memory_bytes and skips profiling; any mismatch profiles fully; each boot atomically saves its result

mechanisms.name: Graph memory estimate during profiling
mechanisms.trigger: determine_available_memory when graphs will be captured
mechanisms.observable: a throwaway capture of sampled FULL graphs extrapolates to all sizes and reduces the KV budget, gated by VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS

mechanisms.name: Scoped allocator max_split_size during load and profiling
mechanisms.trigger: load_model and the profiling pass, on native CUDA or ROCm
mechanisms.observable: max_split_size_mb is 20 inside the scope and restored after, so freed large blocks stay releasable and do not shrink the KV budget

mechanisms.name: Compile and warmup ladder
mechanisms.trigger: once at startup, compile_or_warm_up_model
mechanisms.observable: compile sizes run as dummy forwards, kernels tune, realistic prefill and decode steps run, graphs capture, the --kv-cache-memory suggestion is logged, seed resets
mechanisms.note: warmup_kernels is a title with no steps: the scheduler-shaped prefill and decode through the worker never executes, so nothing it exercises is observed.

mechanisms.name: Post-warmup runtime guards
mechanisms.trigger: the end of compile_or_warm_up_model
mechanisms.observable: the GC heap freezes, the JIT monitor activates, VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK enforces, and inductor lazy init runs early
mechanisms.note: Only the summary mentions the freeze; no behavior step freezes, activates the monitor or enables the sync check.

mechanisms.name: Pipeline-parallel tensor relay between stages
mechanisms.trigger: every step with pipeline_parallel_size > 1
mechanisms.observable: non-first ranks receive intermediate tensors, non-last ranks send theirs, and a step waits on the previous sends; EAGLE3 aux hidden states are relayed to the last rank
mechanisms.note: Send and receive are modeled; configure_aux_hidden_state_relay and relay_aux_hidden_states are not.

mechanisms.name: PP sampled-token broadcast and delayed FIFO
mechanisms.trigger: last rank samples; other ranks every step
mechanisms.observable: sampled tokens reach non-last ranks over a dedicated group, are consumed pp_size steps later, and freed slots are invalidated by a generation counter
mechanisms.note: broadcast_drafts, the req_idx_gen slot generation check and the XPU ring-depth exception are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Prefill context parallel batch partitioning
mechanisms.trigger: every forward with prefill_context_parallel_size > 1
mechanisms.observable: long prefills split into mirrored chunks per rank, hidden states are all-gathered for sampling, dispatch uses the rank token count
mechanisms.note: partition_batch only divides n by pcp_size, without using get-rank-segments; get_num_tokens_for_dispatch and draft prefill partitioning are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Dual batch overlap microbatching (V2)
mechanisms.trigger: a synced DP step above the DBO thresholds, with enable_dbo
mechanisms.observable: two threads run slices of the batch, handing the GPU over at comm points so one all-to-all overlaps the other compute; SM counts split; a thread failure raises on join

mechanisms.name: DBO in the V1 runner: wrapper, capture and veto
mechanisms.trigger: a V1 forward with ubatching on
mechanisms.observable: UBatchWrapper splits and captures microbatches; a step that splits a cached prefix from its writer vetoes microbatching for all ranks

mechanisms.name: Speculative verify and propose cycle
mechanisms.trigger: each step when a speculator is configured
mechanisms.observable: drafts verified in one target forward emit 1 to k+1 tokens, then the speculator proposes next drafts for the scheduler

mechanisms.name: Speculator dispatch by method and draft architecture
mechanisms.trigger: once, in GPUModelRunner.__init__
mechanisms.observable: method and architecture choose one speculator; unknown methods raise NotImplementedError
mechanisms.note: The extract_hidden_states, LiLiCorr and Gemma4 branches are missing, so extract_hidden_states fails as unsupported in the model.

mechanisms.name: Adaptive verification draft budget
mechanisms.trigger: each DSpark step with enable_adaptive_verification
mechanisms.observable: the budget maximizing expected accepted tokens per ms is chosen from cost tables, low-survival drafts are cut, and rows are compacted before the forward

mechanisms.name: Step timing and cost curves
mechanisms.trigger: during capture, plus each dummy forward and drafter call
mechanisms.observable: StepTimingCollector samples forward and drafter time over profile batches into draft and verify cost tables, step functions under the capture limit

mechanisms.name: Online acceptance estimator refit
mechanisms.trigger: each verified step, refit every 100 steps
mechanisms.observable: IRLS accumulators fold verdicts and refit damped coefficients identically on every rank; predict feeds confidences into budgeting
mechanisms.note: step refits on every call rather than every 100, and the predictions reach no budgeting decision because that mechanism is absent.

mechanisms.name: EAGLE, EAGLE3 and single MTP drafting
mechanisms.trigger: each propose with those methods
mechanisms.observable: the first step takes target hidden states; k-1 autoregressive steps feed back each draft

mechanisms.name: Standalone draft model drafting
mechanisms.trigger: each propose with method draft_model
mechanisms.observable: an independent draft model prefills and decodes k drafts, mapping vocabularies when tokenizers differ
mechanisms.note: Only the prefill kernel is a step: decode steps and VocabMapping do not run.

mechanisms.name: DFlash family parallel drafting
mechanisms.trigger: each propose with method dflash or dspark
mechanisms.observable: one forward over a block of mask positions yields all drafts; DFlash2 walks a candidate tree; DSpark adds confidence; LiLiCorr anchors context
mechanisms.note: Kernels are called, but LiLiCorr is missing and draft graph capture and dispatch per draft batch are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Multi-module MTP drafting
mechanisms.trigger: each propose with several MTP layers
mechanisms.observable: each module drafts one position, inputs shift by one per module

mechanisms.name: GPU n-gram drafting
mechanisms.trigger: each propose with ngram or ngram_gpu in V2
mechanisms.observable: the longest and right-most earlier match supplies k drafts; rows without a match repeat the last sampled token

mechanisms.name: Extract hidden states speculator
mechanisms.trigger: each propose with method extract_hidden_states
mechanisms.observable: target hidden states are cached per token while always-accepted drafts return, for use by a downstream aux output

mechanisms.name: V1 proposer dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: each V1 step with a drafter
mechanisms.observable: method chooses the ngram, ngram_gpu, suffix, draft, medusa, Gemma4, Step3p5, custom or hidden-state proposer
mechanisms.note: Only the EAGLE and DFlash kernels are reached from V1 sample_tokens; other proposers never draft.

mechanisms.name: V1 suffix and CPU n-gram proposers
mechanisms.trigger: each V1 propose with suffix or ngram
mechanisms.observable: drafts come from a per-prompt suffix tree cache with eviction, or a numba n-gram scan; ngram_gpu trims invalid drafts from the scheduler output

mechanisms.name: Speculative decoding metric family
mechanisms.trigger: per step per request, and at the log interval
mechanisms.observable: drafts, draft tokens and accepted tokens increment Prometheus counters and the interval logs acceptance length and rates

mechanisms.name: Async device-to-host output copy
mechanisms.trigger: every sampled or pooled step
mechanisms.observable: outputs copy on a separate stream so the copy overlaps proposal; get_output blocks on an event, trims each row and builds the ModelRunnerOutput
mechanisms.note: The output is returned directly: no copy stream, overlap or blocking get_output timing exists.

mechanisms.name: EP all-to-all fault detection on output
mechanisms.trigger: each step on an FT-capable all2all backend
mechanisms.observable: a rank timeout surfaces as a RuntimeError with the active mask when the output is read

mechanisms.name: Fault tolerance retry on a worker
mechanisms.trigger: an EngineCoreSentinel command through handle_ft_command
mechanisms.observable: retry clears step state and every request slot, cleans EP buffers and rebuilds the DP CPU group on new ports
mechanisms.note: retry only synchronizes the device and reports done: slots and execute state stay, and the DP group is not rebuilt. The model also accepts pause, a method the sentinel lacks.

mechanisms.name: NaN logits counting and fail-fast
mechanisms.trigger: each sampling with VLLM_COMPUTE_NANS_IN_LOGITS
mechanisms.observable: NaN counts per request reach the output; VLLM_RAISE_ON_LOGIT_NANS raises when any is found
mechanisms.note: The kernel runs, but counts never reach num_nans_in_logits and the raise path is missing.

mechanisms.name: V2 sampling pipeline
mechanisms.trigger: each step on the last PP rank, no drafts
mechanisms.observable: processors, thinking budget, temperature, min_p, top-k/top-p, then Gumbel or FlashInfer sampling, logprobs and per-request counts, in that order
mechanisms.note: Stage order and gating run as the code; token values are labeled stand-ins, since the model holds no logits.

mechanisms.name: Per-slot sampling state staged to the GPU
mechanisms.trigger: each new request, flushed every step
mechanisms.observable: parameters and processor state stage per slot and flush in one launch before the forward

mechanisms.name: Built-in logits processor chain
mechanisms.trigger: rows that need processing, per sampling
mechanisms.observable: logit bias and min_tokens, penalties, then bad words mask or adjust logits in fixed order

mechanisms.name: Custom logits processor loading and validation
mechanisms.trigger: at model load, and per request for parameters
mechanisms.observable: plugins and FQCNs load; V1-interface plugins are rejected under V2; params validate at the API

mechanisms.name: Thinking token budget enforcement
mechanisms.trigger: requests with a thinking budget, each sampling
mechanisms.observable: committed markers are tracked, and past budget the end-of-thinking token is forced
mechanisms.note: Two kernel calls with no budget comparison or forced token effect; the V1 ThinkingBudgetStateHolder is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: V1 sampler
mechanisms.trigger: each V1 sampling
mechanisms.observable: raw logprobs, non-argmax-invariant processors, then greedy or random sampling chosen per row

mechanisms.name: Batch-sharded sampling across TP ranks
mechanisms.trigger: each sampling with batch sharding on
mechanisms.observable: each rank samples requests owned by slot index mod tp_size; an all-gather restores batch order

mechanisms.name: Structured output grammar masking and draft return
mechanisms.trigger: batches with structured-output requests
mechanisms.observable: logits outside the grammar bitmask are masked, and real drafts copy back for grammar validation instead of -1 placeholders

mechanisms.name: Watermarked sampling
mechanisms.trigger: requests with watermarking enabled
mechanisms.observable: Philox-keyed Gumbel sampling with optional repeated-context dedup; drafts use a draft key, routed by alpha
mechanisms.note: DraftWatermarker.prepare and sample on the draft path, and watermarked_rejection_sample, are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Watermark detection
mechanisms.trigger: a caller scoring generated text
mechanisms.observable: scores token contexts into a p-value and a verdict against the threshold

mechanisms.name: Prompt logprobs including chunked prompts
mechanisms.trigger: requests with prompt_logprobs while prefilling
mechanisms.observable: the next prompt token is scored across chunks and returned with the last chunk; token-id logprobs are computed separately
mechanisms.note: compute_prompt_token_id_logprobs is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Sampled token trace replay
mechanisms.trigger: requests carrying a replay trace, each sampling
mechanisms.observable: sampled tokens are overwritten from the trace
mechanisms.note: Only the kernel call: per-request add_request and staged trace state are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: KV block zeroing and copy-on-write
mechanisms.trigger: each step with new or partially hit blocks
mechanisms.observable: fresh blocks zero before reads, then prefix-cache partial blocks copy before the forward
mechanisms.note: Zeroing runs; copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace appears only in the summary, so block copies are not performed.

mechanisms.name: KV connector hooks around the forward
mechanisms.trigger: each step with a KV connector
mechanisms.observable: metadata binds before the forward; saves are awaited and finished transfers and load errors are returned after; empty steps still drive the connector

mechanisms.name: Encoder cache connector hooks
mechanisms.trigger: each step with EC metadata on the first PP rank
mechanisms.observable: producers save newly computed encoder outputs, consumers load, and finished transfers report back

mechanisms.name: Aux output connector step
mechanisms.trigger: each step with an aux output connector
mechanisms.observable: a step registers before the forward, buffers copy with the output, and the result attaches to get_output

mechanisms.name: Multimodal encoder run and cache
mechanisms.trigger: each step with scheduled encoder inputs
mechanisms.observable: uncached items by mm hash run the encoder; results store until the scheduler frees them; embeddings then gather into inputs

mechanisms.name: Encoder CUDA graphs by token budget
mechanisms.trigger: encoder capture at startup, and each encoder batch
mechanisms.observable: items pack greedily into budget batches that replay the smallest fitting graph or run eager, recording hits and misses
mechanisms.note: Packing and replay choice are modeled; capture only records the budget list, with no forward or pool cost.

mechanisms.name: Multimodal embedding pruning
mechanisms.trigger: multimodal forwards on pruning models
mechanisms.observable: appended position channels are stripped, and M-RoPE positions recompute before merging

mechanisms.name: Prompt embeddings and M-RoPE input preparation
mechanisms.trigger: first PP rank, on steps with embeds or M-RoPE
mechanisms.observable: prompt embeddings overlay inputs_embeds and M-RoPE positions are computed for the batch
mechanisms.note: One kernel call each: values from the request do not reach the model inputs.

mechanisms.name: Encoder-only and encoder-decoder model states
mechanisms.trigger: forwards on those model classes
mechanisms.observable: encoder-only models use their own attention prep; encoder-decoder steps with encoder inputs run eager to update cross-attention

mechanisms.name: Mamba hybrid recurrent state across blocks
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on hybrid models
mechanisms.observable: align mode copies state across block boundaries before the forward; accepted counts and final state commit after

mechanisms.name: RecoverSSM state commit
mechanisms.trigger: each sampled step on KDA models
mechanisms.observable: recovered SSM state commits by sampled count, skipped during capture
mechanisms.note: The commit is a single kernel call; the capture skip and state index conditions do not run.

mechanisms.name: KV sharing fast prefill
mechanisms.trigger: forwards with kv_sharing_fast_prefill and no PCP
mechanisms.observable: a helper prepares a fast prefill path for eligible requests sharing KV layers

mechanisms.name: LoRA adapter add, remove, pin, list
mechanisms.trigger: collective_rpc from the engine
mechanisms.observable: adapters load into an LRU worker cache and are pinned or removed; errors without --enable-lora

mechanisms.name: Per-step LoRA activation and graph variants
mechanisms.trigger: each forward with LoRA enabled; each capture
mechanisms.observable: adapters activate for the batch, active count selects a captured variant clamped to the largest case, and dummy LoRAs let every variant capture
mechanisms.note: The active count passes through, but the dispatch map, capture hook, dummy LoRAs and set_active_mm_loras are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Pooling forward and output
mechanisms.trigger: each execute on a pooling model
mechanisms.observable: the model pooler runs on kept hidden states; unfinished chunked prefills return no output yet

mechanisms.name: Late-interaction query cache with use counts
mechanisms.trigger: doc requests register, and finish or preempt moves the count
mechanisms.observable: a query embedding is held while documents reserve it, released on the last use or by RPC; preempted docs keep their reservation
mechanisms.note: Explicit release and clear are modeled; register_request and on_requests_finished use counts are not.

mechanisms.name: MaxSim scoring with kernel fallback
mechanisms.trigger: scoring of late-interaction documents
mechanisms.observable: one shared query uses the Triton kernel; a kernel failure disables it for the process and falls back to reference MaxSim

mechanisms.name: EPLB integration on the runner
mechanisms.trigger: model load, then after every sample, pool or non-skip dummy run
mechanisms.observable: the MoE model registers and the async loop starts; EplbState steps after each forward unless suppressed
mechanisms.note: maybe_register_speculator and prepare_forward are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Elastic EP warmup isolation
mechanisms.trigger: an elastic scaling warmup on a live worker
mechanisms.observable: slots are removed, KV writes redirect to the null block, and block 0 re-zeroes after; V1 saves and restores block tables
mechanisms.note: gpu-worker-impl.elastic-ep-execute forwards to the distributed area but does not isolate serving state, so it is not listed.

mechanisms.name: RL weight update session
mechanisms.trigger: start, then chunks, then finish RPCs from a trainer
mechanisms.observable: one session at a time; a failed chunk ends it; finishing a target-model update resets LoRA state

mechanisms.name: Reload weights, config override and checksums
mechanisms.trigger: RPCs: update_config, reload_weights, compute_weight_checksums, reset_weights
mechanisms.observable: weights reload in place with LoRA reset; load and model config overrides apply; digests are keyed by rank; parameters can be zeroed
mechanisms.note: update_config with its load_config and model_config allow-list has no interface.

mechanisms.name: Scratch workspace with lanes and lock
mechanisms.trigger: every forward needing scratch; locked after capture
mechanisms.observable: each ubatch and lane slot grows on demand; after locking, growth is an assertion; drafts use their own lane

mechanisms.name: Worker profiler with delayed start and bounds
mechanisms.trigger: profile RPC, then one tick per execute_model
mechanisms.observable: tracing starts after the delay, stops at the iteration bound, and names traces by parallel dimensions; graph capture can be profiled too
mechanisms.note: The graph-capture profiler (_get_cudagraph_capture_context) is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Worker process bootstrap and device init
mechanisms.trigger: once per worker, through init_worker and init_device
mechanisms.observable: plugins load, the distributed environment is ready before the memory snapshot, RNGs seed, and the workspace and runner build

mechanisms.name: Model load and runner assembly
mechanisms.trigger: once at startup
mechanisms.observable: weights load in the weights pool, the model state, processors, sampler, speculator and pooling runner build, and the weight engine is created
mechanisms.note: EC worker services start, set_torch_threads_for_runtime and speculator load with its acceptance estimator are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Runner and worker class selection
mechanisms.trigger: once in init_device, and by platform
mechanisms.observable: MM-encoder, V2 or V1 runner is chosen by config; CPU and XPU workers replace the GPU worker
mechanisms.note: Choice between V1 and V2 is modeled; MMEncoderModelRunner selection and platform worker classes are not.

mechanisms.name: CPU worker and its model runner
mechanisms.trigger: device_type cpu
mechanisms.observable: memory comes from the host, sleep is ignored with a warning, discard raises, and warmup follows its own rule

mechanisms.name: XPU worker and allocator
mechanisms.trigger: device_type xpu
mechanisms.observable: DP device offset, the XpuMemAllocator sleep and wake path, and its own shutdown

mechanisms.name: V1 persistent batch step
mechanisms.trigger: each step with use_v2_model_runner false
mechanisms.observable: the persistent InputBatch updates and condenses, with reorder, forward and bookkeeping that discard or stream tokens per slot
mechanisms.note: Batch maintenance and kernels run. _may_reorder_batch, _bookkeeping_sync, V1 async PP broadcast and V1 pooling do not.

mechanisms.name: V1 CudagraphDispatcher
mechanisms.trigger: at initialization and each V1 dispatch
mechanisms.observable: keys initialize per capture size and mode, then dispatch resolves a key per step
mechanisms.note: Key initialization only; dispatch has no interface.

mechanisms.name: Forward context scope
mechanisms.trigger: around PIECEWISE and eager forwards, and capture
mechanisms.observable: attention metadata, batch descriptor and DP metadata are visible to layers within the block and restored after

mechanisms.name: Worker shutdown and memory release
mechanisms.trigger: engine shutdown
mechanisms.observable: GC unfreezes; KV, EC, profiler, weight engine and elastic executor close; the runner frees tensors, caches and speculator layers
mechanisms.note: Only the weight engine and runner release are steps; other closures are in the summary alone.

mechanisms.name: Idle DP dummy step
mechanisms.trigger: a DP rank with no work while others run
mechanisms.observable: a uniform-decode dummy forward keeps collectives matched across ranks

mechanisms.name: Worker multimodal receiver cache
mechanisms.trigger: each execute_model with new requests, and reset_mm_cache
mechanisms.observable: cached mm features fill in on arrival, and the reset RPC clears them
mechanisms.note: execute-model only marks that the cache was applied; features are not looked up or filled.

mechanisms.name: Checkpoint prepare and restore RPCs
mechanisms.trigger: a process checkpoint around sleep
mechanisms.observable: distributed state is prepared and restored through parallel state

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph runtime stats
mechanisms.trigger: forwards with cudagraph_metrics enabled
mechanisms.observable: per-step graph stats reach the output for the operator
